en.description:
Play Casus Terrae on Apple Watch. Your iPhone is the companion: explore your career, customize Arrow-One in a 3D hangar, compare results and revisit the story. The action game is not played on iPhone.

Free to try: play Level 1 and the route you choose after it, Level 2 or Level 3. A one-time in-app purchase, the Full Game, unlocks the whole campaign, Endless and online co-op. If you first downloaded the game during the free playtest, you keep full access. Previous purchases remain valid; Restore Purchase is available.

Preview paints and effects, then send your choice to the paired Watch. Service and Arctic starter paints are included; other cosmetics use Salvage earned in play. Follow your next reward, review campaign and Endless results, and revisit unlocked comics and English voice recordings with translated transcripts. No ads or subscriptions.

Gameplay requires a compatible Apple Watch with watchOS 27 or later; the iPhone companion requires iOS 27 or later. Personal Watch sync uses its paired iPhone. iPad does not pair with or directly sync a Watch. Online co-op, public scores and restoring purchases require internet.
en.releaseNotes: Level 1 now has a halfway checkpoint: leave after 1:16 and CONTINUE picks up right there. If you step away mid-level, the Watch reminds you that your run is paused. New Game starts faster: pick a difficulty and fly, and choose your callsign after your first Level 1 clear. Comics can now be skipped.

ja.description:
Casus TerraeはApple Watchでプレイするゲームです。iPhoneはコンパニオンとして、戦績の確認、3DハンガーでのArrow-Oneのカスタマイズ、結果の比較、物語の振り返りに使えます。iPhoneではアクションゲームをプレイできません。

無料で体験：レベル1と、その後に選ぶルート（レベル2またはレベル3）をプレイできます。1回限りのアプリ内課金「フルゲーム」で、キャンペーン全編、エンドレスモード、オンライン協力プレイが解除されます。無料プレイテスト期間中に初めてダウンロードした方は、引き続き全コンテンツを利用できます。以前の購入は有効で、復元もできます。

塗装やエフェクトをプレビューして、ペアリングしたWatchに送信。初期塗装のServiceとArcticは付属し、その他の外観はゲームで獲得した資源で入手できます。次の目標や戦績を確認し、解放済みのコミックや翻訳テキスト付き英語音声を楽しめます。広告・サブスクリプションはありません。

プレイにはwatchOS 27以降に対応したApple Watch、iPhoneアプリにはiOS 27以降が必要です。個人のWatchデータの同期にはペアリングしたiPhoneを使用します。iPadはWatchと直接ペアリング・同期しません。オンライン機能と購入にはインターネット接続が必要です。
ja.releaseNotes: レベル1に中間チェックポイントを追加しました。1:16以降に中断しても、「つづきから」でその地点から再開できます。レベルの途中で離れると、Watchが一時停止中であることをお知らせします。ニューゲームはより素早く開始：難易度を選んですぐ出撃、コールサインはレベル1の初クリア後に選べます。コミックをスキップできるようになりました。

de.description:
Spiele Casus Terrae auf der Apple Watch. Dein iPhone ist die Begleitapp: Sieh dir deine Karriere an, gestalte Arrow-One im 3D-Hangar, vergleiche Ergebnisse und erlebe die Geschichte erneut. Das Actionspiel wird nicht auf dem iPhone gespielt.

Kostenlos testen: Spiele Level 1 und die Route, die du danach wählst – Level 2 oder Level 3. Ein einmaliger In-App-Kauf, die Vollversion, schaltet die ganze Kampagne, den Endlosmodus und den Online-Koop frei. Wer das Spiel während des kostenlosen Tests erstmals geladen hat, behält den Vollzugriff. Frühere Käufe bleiben gültig und können wiederhergestellt werden.

Sieh dir Lackierungen und Effekte an und sende deine Auswahl an die gekoppelte Watch. Die Startlackierungen Service und Arctic sind enthalten; weitere kosmetische Extras erhältst du mit erspielten Ressourcen. Verfolge dein nächstes Ziel, prüfe Ergebnisse und entdecke freigeschaltete Comics sowie englische Sprachaufnahmen mit übersetzten Texten. Keine Werbung und keine Abonnements.

Zum Spielen brauchst du eine mit watchOS 27 oder neuer kompatible Apple Watch; die iPhone-App benötigt iOS 27 oder neuer. Persönliche Watch-Daten werden über das gekoppelte iPhone synchronisiert. Das iPad koppelt und synchronisiert sich nicht direkt mit der Watch. Online-Funktionen und Käufe benötigen Internet.
de.releaseNotes: Level 1 hat jetzt einen Checkpoint zur Hälfte: Verlässt du es nach 1:16, geht es mit FORTSETZEN genau dort weiter. Gehst du mitten im Level weg, erinnert dich die Watch, dass dein Spiel pausiert ist. Neues Spiel startet schneller: Schwierigkeit wählen und losfliegen, dein Rufzeichen wählst du nach dem ersten geschafften Level 1. Comics lassen sich jetzt überspringen.

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Your iPhone Hangar is here: a rotating 3D ship, paints and effects, career charts, reward goals, comics and an English voice archive with translated transcripts. New players can play Levels 1–2 free; one Full Game purchase adds Levels 3–10, Endless and online co-op. Existing paid customers keep their full-game access. Purchase and restore from the iPhone companion. Gameplay remains on Apple Watch.

A short, skippable gameplay introduction now welcomes you on first launch.
New iPhone players can choose whether to help us measure installs from our ads on X. You can play every feature without allowing tracking. The Apple Watch game does not request tracking permission.
Play all ten campaign levels, Endless, and online co-op for free on Apple Watch. First-time App Store downloads during the playtest keep full access. Existing purchases and progress are preserved.
Small update. The iPhone app can now ask for an App Store rating once you have cleared Level 2 on your Apple Watch. The free full-game playtest continues: all ten levels, Endless and online co-op.

Enjoying the free playtest? A rating or review on the App Store helps an independent developer more than anything. You can now rate the game from the iPhone app any time: More › Rate Casus Terrae. Also new: Install on Apple Watch in the iPhone app walks you through putting the game on your Watch, with fixes if it doesn't show up. The free full-game playtest continues: all ten levels, Endless and online co-op.

Easier on every difficulty: your ship now has a recharging shield that takes a hit instead of a life (every 15 s on Easy, 30 s on Normal, 60 s on Hard). Enemies fire fewer, slower shots, bosses go down faster, and you stay protected longer after a hit. After Level 1 you now choose your way down: the Cave or the Lava Trench. The other route stays in Level Select. The Excellent, Deadly and Lethal combo callouts are now spoken in your language. Also included from 1.1.5: after your first Level 1 win, the Watch asks once whether you'd like to rate the game. Tap Rate on iPhone to finish on your phone, or scan the code with your iPhone camera. It never asks again. The free full-game playtest continues.

The free playtest has ended. New players can try Level 1 and the route they pick after it (Level 2 or Level 3) for free. One Full Game purchase unlocks the rest of the campaign, Endless and online co-op. If you first downloaded Casus Terrae during the playtest, you keep the full game. Also new: RATE at the end of the Watch's main menu, and Rate on iPhone now opens Apple's own rating window the next time you open the iPhone app. After your first Level 2 or Level 3 win, the Watch asks once more whether you'd like to rate the game, unless you already chose Rate on iPhone.

The Full Game's price is now easy to find before you play. The Watch's main menu has a FULL GAME row, right under NEW GAME, that shows the price and opens the unlock screen, and the iPhone app shows the price on the Career tab. Level 1 and the route you pick after it (Level 2 or Level 3) stay free.

Level 1 has all-new painted art: the enemies, the boss, the ground units and the whole landscape. More reasons to keep flying. Every campaign level you clear now earns Salvage, with a bonus for a first clear and for each medal. Spend it on two new PERKS: SHIELD+ (each level's opening shield takes two hits) and +1 BOMB. Runs with a perk on aren't ranked. New DAILY, right under NEW GAME: a new run every day with its own daily leaderboard, free for every player. If you allow notifications, the 6 PM reminder now opens it, and you can add Casus Terrae to your watch face to jump straight in. Retry now restarts the level you were on, on every difficulty, and the controls demo, training and callsign appear only on your first New Game. Smoother play: fewer stutters when a boss arrives, and tilt steering keeps working after a slowdown. New in Settings: SHARE ANONYMOUS STATS sends anonymous level counts, with no identifiers, so we can see where players get stuck. It's on by default and you can turn it off at any time.

After each level you clear and each Daily or Endless run, the Watch now shows where your Salvage goes further: new ship paint in the iPhone Hangar. Store prices now stay up to date while the app is open. Bug fixes and small improvements.
After you clear Level 1, the Watch now offers the Full Game, which unlocks every level, or lets you keep playing free on the level that comes next. Bug fixes and small improvements.

Level 1 now has a halfway checkpoint: leave after 1:16 and CONTINUE picks up right there. If you step away mid-level, the Watch reminds you that your run is paused. New Game starts faster: pick a difficulty and fly, and choose your callsign after your first Level 1 clear. Comics can now be skipped.
